title: Pub-Sub Broker with Consumer Groups
summary: A Kafka-lite in-memory broker: topics as append-only logs, per-group offsets, poll/seek/lag, and exactly-once delivery within a group under concurrency.
hints: A topic is an append-only `List<String>`. The offset is simply the list index. Publishing returns `size` before the append.
Each topic keeps a `Map<group, Long>` of committed offsets. Consumers in the same group **share** one offset, which is how a group splits the work.
`poll` must read the offset, slice the messages and advance the offset **atomically**. Otherwise two consumers in a group get the same messages.
One lock per topic is a good granularity: publishes to different topics never contend.
